notes.title: 1.5 CRT SHADER UPDATE!
notes.notes:
In the 1.5 update we completely overhauled the games look by adding an older style CRT shader! ːsteamhappyː

We've made sure that the new shader does not affect gameplay in any major way! But it does add a completely new look to the game that fits much better with the arcade genre of Alpine!

Updated Badger’s Dialogue to show how to continue conversation
Fixed Stone Texture Clipping bug
Fixed Player escaping from the “rock spawn zone” if using the rocket in endless mode bug
Fixed Alpine Icon Image not being shown on Windows bug
Removed white border around game window
